remediation_observations: A refresh primitive now propagates getAllParameters failures while the user-triggered loader remains responsible for rendering ordinary load errors.
The post-mutation refresh boundary converts refresh failure into an accessible alert and returns false before any success status is emitted.
Create and update reset the editor and return to list after persisted mutation plus refresh failure, preventing an accidental second mutation submission.
Delete and category rename do not emit success when the immediate refresh fails; the alert directs the user to the existing Atualizar recovery action.
Recovery through Atualizar performs only getAllParameters and does not repeat the mutation.
